headword: {名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}
gloss: local specialty dish; famous regional cuisine

definitions.gloss: local specialty dish; famous regional cuisine
definitions.explanation: A dish that a particular region or restaurant is famous for, often closely associated with local ingredients and culinary traditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たこ{焼|や}き→たこ焼き：10364_takoyaki⟧だ。
examples.english: Osaka's famous local dish is takoyaki.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅先|たびさき}→旅先：12949_tabisaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ようにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I travel, I always make sure to eat the local specialty dishes.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三十年|さんじゅうねん}⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{変|か}わらない→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}り→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This restaurant's signature dish has maintained the same taste for over thirty years.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{名物|めいぶつ}→名物：05591_meibutsu⟧ (famous product; specialty) and ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧ (cooking; cuisine). Japan has a rich culture of regional specialty foods, and trying {名物料理|めいぶつりょうり} is considered an essential part of travel. Nearly every prefecture and city has its own signature dishes, such as {博多|はかた}⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧ in Fukuoka, ⟦{味噌|みそ}→味噌：01037_miso⟧カツ in Nagoya, and {讃岐|さぬき}⟦うどん→うどん：05182_udon⟧ in Kagawa.
